name: StarHub Ltd
summary: StarHub Ltd engages in the operation and provision of telecommunications services and other businesses relating to the info-communications industry for individuals and businesses in Singapore. The company operates through two segments, Telecommunications and Cyber Security. It provides television subscription and broadcasting services; mobile telecommunications; broadband access; and security consultancy services, investment holding, information security systems integrator.
